rules.plain: When E26 <= 3.50 and E9 <= 2.50, the tree predicts broken.
When E26 <= 3.50 and E9 > 2.50 and E20 <= 0.50, the tree predicts healthy.
When E26 <= 3.50 and E9 > 2.50 and E20 > 0.50, the tree predicts broken.
When E26 > 3.50 and E23 <= 1.00 and E26 <= 10.00, the tree predicts healthy.
When E26 > 3.50 and E23 <= 1.00 and E26 > 10.00, the tree predicts broken.
When E26 > 3.50 and E23 > 1.00 and E2 <= 3.50, the tree predicts broken.
When E26 > 3.50 and E23 > 1.00 and E2 > 3.50, the tree predicts healthy.
